clips.title: The story
paras: Along Lake Everstill, Murloc Poachers are stripping Lakeshire's waters of fish. Dockmaster Baren needs you to thin their swelling ranks before the town loses its main food supply.

Dockmaster Baren needs you to protect the fish that feed Lakeshire. Lake Everstill supplies the mountain town and its market with fresh catches. Large tribes of murlocs now crowd the shallows and scour the waters for food. Left unchecked, they could wipe out the local fish and leave Lakeshire without its main food supply.

Murlocs usually scavenge along the coast, so their numbers high in the Redridge Mountains are hard to explain. Dockmaster Baren wonders why they have come so far from the open ocean. They may be fleeing predators at sea, losing territorial fights, or drawn by Lake Everstill's plentiful waters. Whatever brought them inland, their presence points to trouble elsewhere in the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Murlocs are becoming a problem. Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm! We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!
Hunt murlocs! Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those fins? Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.
It's strange seeing them so far from the sea. I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
